d:
Relive Amrinder Gill's timeless romantic hit Laazmi Dil Da Kho Jaana, now in stunning 8K Jatinder Shah's melody and Kumaar's lyrics carry Amrinder Gill's soulful voice in a song about losing your heart the moment love finds you, with Amrit Maghera on screen.
Every frame is sharper than ever, so you can fall in love with this classic all over again.
Song Credits
Speed Records, Aman Khatkar & Arsara Films Presents
Produced By – Suresh Kumar, Monty Shoor, Sukhjinder Bhachu & Aman Khatkar
